skills.name: Severed Time (岁痕之断)
skills.line: I shall safeguard the peace of time.
skills.description: SP Takiyasha Hime attacks a single target dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK.

skills.name: Time Travel (曜时之旅)
skills.line: I shall carry forward the light of the sun and moon that once existed.
skills.description: Exclusive effect. Each time SP Takiyasha Hime's HP is decreased by 25%, she consumes 1 Recall stack. Each time a Recall stack is consumed, her damage reduction is increased by 15% and SPD by 15, max of 3 stacks and sustained for 1 turn. ;Upon Usage :SP Takiyasha Hime enters the Rift in Time and gains 3 Recall stacks. ;Recall (回溯) : :'''General, Status''': Max of 3 stacks. Each time SP Takiyasha Hime consumes 3 stacks, she escapes in the Rift in Time and recovers her max HP; when fighting against monsters, automatically uses Time Travel once.

upgrades.text: When she has 3 Recall stacks, becomes immune to control effects and effects such as Banish.
At the start of battle, automatically gain 3 Recall stacks.

skills.name: Time Slash (烬时之斩)
skills.line: Night and day, past and future. These are the threads that weave fate.
skills.description: SP Takiyasha Hime attacks a targeted enemy 3 times, dealing damage equal to 82% of her ATK with each attack. Then consumes 1 Recall stack to attack all enemies 3 times, dealing damage equal to 12%, 24% and 136% of her ATK respectively. ;Recall (回溯) : :'''General, Status''': Max of 3 stacks. Each time SP Takiyasha Hime consumes 3 stacks, she escapes in the Rift in Time and recovers her max HP; when fighting against monsters, automatically uses Time Travel once. ;Moment of Silence (时寂之刻) : :Cannot be dispelled, cannot take actions, cannot deal damage, equipped souls lose effect.

upgrades.text: Damage for the last attack increases to 161%.
When used while in the Rift in Time, damage dealt increases by 45%.
Damage for the last attack increases to 186%.
When used while in the Rift in Time, everyone other than herself will enter a Moment of Silence.

bio.condition: Increase SP Takiyasha Hime's level to 40.
Increase SP Takiyasha Hime's skills 12 times.
Team SP Takiyasha Hime with another player's Himiko and clear any zone 10 times.
